payload.note: The complete order-lambda4 pair-response ledger has been reduced from 1226 raw Wick pairings, 1046 connected pairings, and 27 connected adjacency types to six momentum-admissible topology types. Twenty-one types contain a non-self bridge; summing action-vertex conservation on either side forces bridge momentum zero, so G_L(0)=0 kills them exactly. All Dm1 rows vanish, only the top-degree Dm3-S1 graph survives, and only one Dm2-S1-S1 graph survives. The exact coefficient is now one zero-loop, one one-loop, and four two-loop terms. L=6 supersedes coordinate-space L=4 because the range-two quadratic response aliases on the 4-torus. The full L6 coefficient, large-volume behavior, fixed-coupling response, response-to-Witten bridge, actual interacting H^-1, continuum, Born, Krein, and Lorentzian gates remain open.
